objective: Test recognition of exact equality to a single specified implication and of definability using positive implications plus unary pins when an arbitrarily long fixed guarded prefix precedes the two ports.
status: Proved: Recognizing the exact individual implication h→k or representability by unary conditions and positive implications is NP-hard on fixed two-use layouts with only guard settings varying. Four parallel feasibility queries recover the report at fixed local ends.
title: Recognizing the required two-choice report on fixed guarded wiring
